verdict.summary: The workflow-only change correctly adds Cargo's `--lib` target alongside each existing explicit integration-test target, causing feature-gated unit tests in the library to run without removing or weakening the conformance runners, floor assertions, retry/error handling, or output checks. The selected features match the relevant module gates: `jsonld-suite` exposes `jsonld_bench`, `http-protocol` forwards to `service-loopback` for `http_protocol`, `federation-descriptors` exposes `sd_gsp`, and the QL/DL features expose their inference unit-test modules. Cargo supports combining `--lib` with one or more `--test` selectors, so both target classes are exercised. No security, soundness, test-validity, or completeness defect is apparent in the diff.
